description: Applies DNA motif discovery to binary representations of Collatz delay records, finding enriched binary patterns that guide candidate construction.
mathematical_formalization: Enrichment E(motif) = freq_in_records / freq_in_random. Significance by Fisher's exact test.
implementation_hypothesis: MEME-like motif discovery on binary strings of delay records. Construct candidates from enriched motifs.
experiment_seed: 131 known delay records, 8-bit motifs, 10000 synthetic candidates.
